html:
Paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you the most exciting feelings, when you can fly in the sky of Da Nang to see the city from above, with bridges, statues of Bodhisattva Avalokitesvara located majestically overlooking the East Sea, and poetic beaches.

If you are a sports lover, want to experience adventure sports, then paragliding in Son Tra Peninsula is one of the sports for you, you will be flying with a guide in the sky to admire the beauty of Da Nang from above.

The experience of paragliding in the sky will bring you different emotions, the paragliding experience starts at an altitude of 700m above sea level in an ideal position for you to both parachute and experience flying in the sky to enjoy the scenery from above.

What is paragliding?

Paragliding is an adventure sport not for the faint-hearted, when participating, visitors will be flying in the sky looking like seagulls spreading their wings.

When flying, visitors are seated in the cabin, with safety belts, so they can feel completely secure and look out the window to see the beautiful scenery. Most visitors, after experiencing it, do not feel as scared as at first.

How long does it take to paraglide on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang, Vietnam?

If you calculate the travel time from the foot of Son Tra Peninsula to the take-off point, and when landing on the ground, it takes about 10 minutes, and the check-in procedures take about 20 minutes, then visitors will go to the flight point, which is the top of the chessboard, 15 – 20 minutes, visitors will take souvenir photos for about 5 minutes.

Son Tra Peninsula in Da Nang is a great destination and a suitable place to participate in paragliding, on the top is a gently sloping land surrounded by primeval forests. To participate in paragliding, you will fly with a pilot, you will see the whole view of Son Tra, Linh Ung Pagoda, My Khe beach and the whole view of Da Nang from above.

This is one of the adventure sports, so when participating you need to follow the instructions of the guide, and must ensure your health, to ensure your safety.

Son Tra Paragliding Which Season Is The Best

To have the best Son Tra paragliding experience, you should go from March to September, at this time the climate in Da Nang is relatively beautiful, sunny and windy, the sky is clear, very suitable for tourists to experience paragliding adventures in the sky of Da Nang.

Experiences when you paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula

  • Before flying, you often feel nervous, and somewhat excited to blend in with nature.
  • From above, you can admire the scenery of Da Nang, and the majestic Linh Ung Pagoda with the majestic statue of Quan Am facing the East Sea.
  • You can save for yourself the most beautiful moments in the sky of Da Nang

Can you paragliding on Son Tra Peninsula, Da Nang?

If this is your first time participating, you will definitely be hesitant, but according to Vietlook’s experience of traveling to Da Nang, you can absolutely participate in the flight, because there are also professional guides flying with you, and before flying you will be instructed very carefully so you can be completely assured.

Before flying, you will sign a commitment according to your health regulations.

However, paragliding is not suitable for pregnant women, and those with cardiovascular diseases, asthma, epilepsy, hypocalcemia, etc.

It can be said that when experiencing Son Tra paragliding from above, visitors can admire the beauty of Da Nang city, the city of festivals and events, and see the scenery from a completely new angle, which will bring you the most enjoyable experiences.

So if you are a sports lover, go on a tour to Da Nang today and participate in paragliding at Son Tra Peninsula Da Nang will bring you exciting feelings.
